summary: Iteration 15 fully verified. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass in tests/test_iteration15.py covering (1) Expiry: POST /api/documents with expires_on (YYYY-MM-DD) returns expires_on + expiry_status (expired/soon/ok) + days_left, invalid format → 400, PUT can set/clear, GET /api/documents/expiring returns only expired+soon for active project sorted soonest first (expired item first). (2) Folders: POST /api/doc-folders creates folder with foreign/invalid ids filtered (foreign-only payload → 400), returns {id,title,doc_count=2,url .../api/f/{token}}; GET list; public GET /api/f/{token} HTML contains #folder-title, #folder-count, .folder-doc links, #folder-zip; /api/f/{token}/zip returns ZIP with granted docs; /api/f/{token}/d/{did} 200 for granted, 404 for non-granted; DELETE → page shows 'no longer active' and ZIP 404. (3) Portal owner API: POST /api/portal-members validates https origin (http → 400), returns member with handle 'x@buildassist', unique global, suffix number if taken (wanted handle collision), reused for same email across different projects; duplicate email same project → 400; PUT doc_ids filters foreign ids, flips digest/role; POST /{id}/resend hits 2-min cooldown 429; DELETE works. (4) Portal auth: POST /api/portal/request-code returns generic ok for unknown AND known identifiers; wrong verify code → 401 with attempts incremented; correct code (via overwriting db.portal_codes hash with routes.portal._code_hash(email,'123456')) → {token}. Portal token rejected by owner GET /api/project (401) and owner token rejected by GET /api/portal/me (401). (5) Portal data: GET /api/portal/me lists shared projects with handle+email; GET /api/portal/projects/{pid}?week=0 returns summary + ONLY granted documents + digest (null when digest=false); GET /api/portal/projects/{pid}/documents/{did} 200 for granted/404 for non-granted; non-member project (random id) → 404. (6) Portal web page GET /api/portal contains #ident, #send-code, #code, #verify, #portal-project, #portal-digest, #portal-docs markers. (7) Cascade: DELETE /api/auth/account removes portal_members + doc_folders (folder public page → 'no longer active'); DELETE /api/projects/{pid} removes documents + doc_folders + portal_members for that project. Frontend (390x844 mobile): logged in via /api/auth/login (demo@mybuilder.app/demo1234), uploaded 'TEST_UI15_gas' Gas certificate with +10d expiry → dashboard expiry-alert-card renders with expiry-item-{id}; tapping it opens /documents (documents-screen) and the row shows document-expiry-{id} badge; documents-portal-button navigates to /portal-access (portal-access-screen) — portal-name-input, portal-email-input, portal-role-investor, portal-invite-button enabled when name+valid email supplied; after invite portal-member-{id} appears with portal-member-handle-{id} ending '@buildassist'; documents-select-toggle → document-pick-{id} → documents-share-folder-button opens folder-sheet (folder-title-input, folder-create-button) → folder-url returns .../api/f/{token} with folder-copy-button; documents-folders-button lists folder-row-{id} with folder-revoke-{id}; /document-form document-expiry-input invalid '31/03/2027' keeps document-save-button aria-disabled=true (plus other required fields).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/documents.py public_folder (/api/f/{token}) treats a folder with zero resolved docs the same as a missing/revoked token ('no longer active'). If an owner edits documents to point outside the project, stakeholders see the same 'revoked' message — consider distinguishing 'empty folder' vs 'revoked'. Reference: routes/documents.py:277-278.

routes/portal.py request_code silently drops the 4th send within 15 minutes (len(sends) < 3 gate) without any indication to the user. Message is still generic 'ok' which is correct for anti-enumeration, but legitimate users retrying several times get no code and no feedback. Reference: routes/portal.py:181-194.

routes/portal.py _resolve returns None (and request-code is a no-op) for an email that was invited and then removed from every project — correct for revocation. However the same gate also hides a stakeholder whose only project was deleted, which may surprise owners re-inviting the same email because they can't test with their old portal_handle until a new membership exists. Non-blocking. Reference: routes/portal.py:168-173.

routes/portal.py add_member swallows invite-email failure with just a logger.warning. Owner sees 'invited' in the UI even if Resend rejects the address — consider surfacing a soft warning in the response. Reference: routes/portal.py:112-117.

frontend/app/portal-access.tsx add.onSuccess calls setOpen(m.id) so the newly invited member is auto-expanded, which is nice; but the toggle Pressable also handles clicks, so a tap on the just-created card collapses it. Minor UX point — consider skipping the toggle when the card is auto-opened for a few seconds, or show a subtle 'just invited' hint. Reference: frontend/app/portal-access.tsx:26-29, 67-74.

frontend/app/portal-access.tsx 'origin_url: BACKEND_URL' assumes BACKEND_URL is https; the server rejects http at /api/portal-members with 400 but there is no frontend-side guard — if a dev points EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL at http://localhost the invite will fail with 'Portal links need an https address' which can be confusing. Reference: frontend/app/portal-access.tsx:26.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test registers a disposable TEST_ user via /api/auth/register (unique email) and deletes it via DELETE /api/auth/account afterwards (which cascades documents + folders + portal_members). Frontend run uploaded one TEST_UI15_gas document to the demo user, invited one TEST UI Dave stakeholder (delivered+ui15…@resend.dev) and created one TEST_UI15 folder; all three were deleted via API at the end of the run. Demo plan stays 'basic'; demo now has 0 TEST_ artefacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Load /app/backend/.env + /app/frontend/.env with python-dotenv at test module top (shell env quoting mangles MONGO_URL="mongodb://…" otherwise). To test portal verify in automated tests, overwrite db.portal_codes {email: <lowercased>} with hash=routes.portal._code_hash(email,'123456'), expires=time.time()+300, attempts=0, sends=[time.time()]. Portal JWT uses PORTAL_SECRET = JWT_SECRET + '|portal' — owner tokens and portal tokens are deliberately NOT interchangeable (both return 401 cross-boundary). The 2-min resend cooldown fires 429 for a freshly-invited member because invited_at is set at creation. Folder-sheet's "folder-done-button" closes the sheet (resets state), so to re-open the list use documents-folders-button. Dashboard /(tabs) auto-queries /api/documents/expiring on mount — need to upload at least one soon/expired doc first for expiry-alert-card to render.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iteration-15 features (document expiry warnings, revocable folder links, stakeholder portal with passwordless handle/email + per-document grants + weekly digest toggle + cascading deletes) verified end-to-end on backend and frontend. Portal token / owner token boundary is enforced correctly (both directions return 401).
